text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's kicking off again this year! The 
Classic race season!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, first up is the Oka Sho! I wonder if 
a Triple Tiara Umamusume will emerge!?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Look, Orfevre achieved the Classic Triple 
Crown last year, right? Maybe it'll happen 
again this year!?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I wonder how this year will go? 
There's just so much top-tier talent.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The girl who won Best Junior Queen 
Umamusume seems to have incredible 
ability, but...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for Gentildonna-san! Just 
looking at her, you can tell how powerful 
she is!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"No, Verxina is a real possibility too. I 
hear she's got great speed..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I see... It feels like a clash of rivals, 
huh? Looks like this year's gonna be 
exciting too! —The Tiara route, that is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The much-anticipated first leg of the 
Tiara route. Fan predictions seem fairly 
split across the board—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't feel as overwhelmingly dominated 
by Gentildonna as Verxina had always made 
it out to be. Even so, however—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If anyone were to stand in my way today...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That is undeniably... that person.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just how terrifying she can be... I know 
all too well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I was surprised to learn that the run 
I thought matched pace with mine was an 
illusion, but—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am twice as strong as I was back then. 
There is no problem!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Verxina from right after her debut 
would have panicked over falling behind. 
But the current Verxina is brimming with 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, at last... It is finally 
about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My path leading to the queen... to the 
pinnacle itself!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Big sis came out!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Heeey, heee~y! Good luck, Big Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if you don't raise your voice 
like that, I think they can hear you..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to send her the biggest cheer 
possible! Come on, Cheval-chi, send some 
power too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need it. Even without that... 
Big Sis will be fine—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Cheval-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait... I just got a chill... Could 
this be—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: From the paddock...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I see. I have already witnessed... the 
extent of everyone's power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Fufufufu...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems there won't even be a need for 
me to force my path open, after all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(What is that sheer intensity... 
Gentil-san is without a doubt...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(――They've become so much stronger than 
before...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“However, that goes for me as well. ……No, 
it is not the same.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm... the stronger one right now! Without 
a doubt...!
